headword: {交通安全|こうつうあんぜん}

definitions.explanation: The concept and practice of preventing traffic accidents and ensuring safe conditions on roads and at intersections.

examples.japanese: {交通安全|こうつうあんぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけましょう→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's be careful about traffic safety.

examples.english: A traffic safety class was held at the school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{交通安全|こうつうあんぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧ (traffic, transportation) + ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧ (safety). An extremely common compound in daily Japanese life, seen on signs, at shrines, in schools, and in public campaigns.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traffic safety charms ({交通安全|こうつうあんぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧) are among the most popular types of charms sold at Japanese shrines and temples. Many new car owners have their vehicles blessed (⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{祓|はら}い→お祓い：15835_oharai⟧) for traffic safety. Nationwide {交通安全|こうつうあんぜん}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ campaigns are held twice yearly in spring and autumn.
